extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for preparing and uploading manuscripts (especially TeX/LaTeX and PDF) and associated metadata/files for submission to arXiv, including format, file-naming, moderation, and versioning rules. Covers required agreements, processing checks, common errors, and availability scheduling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topicality and refereeable contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions to arXiv should be topical and refereeable scientific contributions that follow accepted standards of scholarly communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All submissions are moderated to verify material is appropriate and topical. Material that contains offensive language, non-scientific content, or is plagiarized may be removed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Registered author requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv only accepts submissions from registered authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you are a new user or are submitting to a new category, you may be required to find endorsements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Moderation and content standards
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions are subject to a moderation process that verifies material is appropriate and topical.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Moderation may remove material with offensive language, non-scientific content, or plagiarism. Authors must also agree to arXiv's code of conduct, moderation, and privacy policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: License to distribute
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors must grant arXiv.org an irrevocable license to distribute the work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a required condition of submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agreement to submission terms and policies
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors must agree to the Submittal Agreement and abide by the code of conduct, moderation, and privacy policies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreement to these policies is mandatory to complete submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Self-submission expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Authors are expected to self-submit their articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions by a third party are accepted only under limited conditions; see separate instructions for third-party and index submissions for conference proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Announcement scheduling (timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: New submissions received by 14:00 (Eastern) are generally made available at 20:00 (Eastern) based on the schedule for availability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Versions help pages and schedule for availability provide details. Edits and final submission before 14:00 Monday–Friday will not delay announcement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted text submission formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted submission formats (in order of preference): (La)TeX, AMS(La)TeX, PDFLaTeX; PDF and HTML are accepted in some cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: arXiv's goal is to store articles in portable, stable formats and currently considers TeX/LaTeX the best choice. arXiv does not accept dvi, PS, or PDF created from TeX/LaTeX source, and scanned documents are not accepted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted figure formats and processing requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Accepted figure formats: PostScript (PS, EPS) — requires LaTeX processing; JPEG, GIF, PNG or PDF figures — requires PDFLaTeX processing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not omit figures (external links to view figures are not acceptable). If using (La)TeX source, use the appropriate figure formats for your chosen processor; arXiv does not perform figure file conversion for you.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of standard figure macros
rubrics_metrics.description: If you submit figures with your (La)TeX source, use standard macro packages (e.g., graphics and graphicx) to have figures appear in the document.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: arXiv administration cannot provide help with TeX-related issues—use standard packages to ensure correct rendering.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prohibition on omitted figures and external links
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions with omitted figures are not accepted, even if links to view figures externally are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All figures must be included in the submission in acceptable formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: File name character restrictions
rubrics_metrics.description: arXiv will accept only the following characters in file names: a-z A-Z 0-9 _ + - . , =
rubrics_metrics.guidance: File names containing other characters (e.g., spaces, question marks, asterisks) will be rejected to ensure portability and minimize archival risk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Case sensitivity of file names and internal references
rubrics_metrics.description: File names and extensions are case sensitive on arXiv's system; internal references must match case exactly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Figure1.PDF and figure1.pdf are not the same. Ensure LaTeX source references match the exact case used in file names.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inclusion of ancillary files is limited
rubrics_metrics.description: There are limited facilities for including data sets and ancillary files (data, programs, etc.) associated with articles submitted to arXiv.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See separate instructions about including data sets and ancillary files for details on allowed formats and procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title and abstract metadata preparation
rubrics_metrics.description: Prepare title and abstract for inclusion in metadata following separate instructions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This metadata is used on abstract pages, in announcements, in RSS feeds, and to support searching; verify it carefully during submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Upload mechanics and allowed archive formats
rubrics_metrics.description: Use the START NEW SUBMISSION button; you can upload single files or use zip or tar.gz to upload multiple files, subfolders, and ancillary files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The option to drag files into the browser submission window is not currently available.

rubrics_metrics.name: File review and deletion before processing
rubrics_metrics.description: After upload, review your files and delete any unnecessary files; you can delete single files or use Delete All to restart the upload process.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Carefully manage uploaded files to avoid extraneous content; a pop-up will prompt confirmation for deletions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Automated file checking (Check Files)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use Check Files to analyze uploaded files to identify the correct processor, the top-level TeX file, and potential extraneous files for deletion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notice which compiler was auto-detected and which file was auto-detected as the Top-Level TeX file; you can choose a different compiler or top-level file via dropdowns.

rubrics_metrics.name: Top-Level TeX file detection rules
rubrics_metrics.description: Only TeX files containing \documentclass directives will be shown on the list of possible top-level files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may choose multiple top-level files; the resulting article will contain the TeX output of all selected files concatenated together in order.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review Auto-detected Notes and recommended deletions
rubrics_metrics.description: Carefully review the Auto-detected Notes for uploaded files and note which files are recommended for deletion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Uncheck deletion recommendations if the file should not be deleted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compilation success and preview step
rubrics_metrics.description: If your file compiles successfully you may Preview your PDF and then continue to the Metadata page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If compilation fails, examine common causes listed and correct them before resubmitting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Common compilation/processing mistakes to check
rubrics_metrics.description: Five most common mistakes: mixed figure file formats; file-name upper/lower-case mismatch between TeX source and figure/included files; default hyperref failures are not reasons to report a failure to arXiv; missing customized or differing versions of style files; missing, misnamed, or local complete paths to figure files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure figures are in the appropriate formats for your compiler (PDFLaTeX vs LaTeX), convert files as needed, match file name cases exactly, include required style files, and use correct figure paths. Continue scrolling in the compilation log to find specific errors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify and correct before final submission
rubrics_metrics.description: Before clicking the final Submit Article step, carefully check the title and abstract metadata and the processed files and correct any errors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact arXiv administrators for help if needed. If you discover an error after submission but before public announcement, use the Unsubmit feature to return it to incomplete status and modify files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsubmit and resubmission policy
rubrics_metrics.description: If you discover an error after submission but before public announcement, select the Unsubmit icon to return the article to incomplete status to allow modification and resubmission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unsubmitting an article takes it out of the processing queue; announcement will be scheduled based on the later resubmission time. See the schedule of availability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Versioning and edit-before-announcement rules
rubrics_metrics.description: No additional versions are generated when edits are done before the submission is publicly announced; the date stamp associated with the submission will be the time the final Submit Article step is completed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Edits and final submission before 14:00 US Eastern Time Monday–Friday will not delay announcement. Do NOT make a new submission for a corrected article or for an erratum—replace the original submission instead.

rubrics_metrics.name: Availability of submissions and public availability information
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about when submissions become publicly available is provided on arXiv's public submission availability page.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the availability page and versions help pages for details about announcement scheduling and version history.
